_README: RETIRED 2026-08-20 -- nothing reads this file any more. Kept as the historical
record of the last hand-typed monthly report (June 2026 sold figures).
Why it was retired: every figure here is a SOLD statistic (median sale price, days
to sell, sale-to-list, luxury closings), and this site's MLS feed deliberately never
replicates Sold/Closed listings -- see REPLICATED_STATUSES in the shared backend,
'the strictest possible version of no sold/closed data'. So the page could never be
automated from the feed, and a hand-typed page skips a month and goes quietly stale
on the one page that exists to prove Christine is on top of the market.

region.weighted_median_note: Weighted by each town's sale count, so a handful of sales in a small town cannot skew the regional figure.

takeaway: Sellers are still landing close to ask, and buyers are winning on the homes that were priced properly to begin with. In the $1M+ tier days on market run longer because those buyers are deliberate rather than hesitant -- pricing precision, not pricing volume, decides whether a luxury property trades inside 60 days or sits for six months.
